title: GTA 6 Runs at 30 FPS, Even on PS5 Pro: Rockstar Confirms 🎮 #Shorts
description:
Rockstar confirmed on Nov 10, 2026 (as GTA 6 pre-loading went live) that Grand Theft Auto VI targets 30 frames per second on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, including PS5 Pro. PS5 Pro gets ray-traced shadows only available on that console plus PSSR clarity improvements; PS5 gets DualSense haptics, Tempest 3D Audio and improved load times; Xbox One can play via cloud streaming using Xbox Series S settings.
Sources: Rockstar Games statement (Pre-load Grand Theft Auto VI Now), reported by VGC and GamingBible. Footage: official Rockstar Games trailers (Pre-Load Now, Launch Trailer).
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
